capstone/evaluation.title: Capstone Project Evaluation Criteria
capstone/evaluation.description: The Capstone Project serves as the ultimate demonstration of a learner's mastery of the concepts and skills acquired throughout the "Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics Course." This document outlines the clear evaluation criteria used to assess the project's success, focusing on functionality, robustness, adherence to requirements, and the quality of technical documentation.

module3-ai-brain/chapter1-isaac-sim-intr.title: Chapter 1: Introduction to NVIDIA Isaac Sim
module3-ai-brain/chapter1-isaac-sim-intr.description: NVIDIA Isaac Sim is a powerful, scalable robotics simulation platform built on NVIDIA Omniverse. It accelerates the development, testing, and deployment of AI-enabled robots by providing a highly realistic and physically accurate virtual environment. Isaac Sim is designed for a wide range of robotics applications, from manufacturing and logistics to healthcare and autonomous vehicles.

module3-ai-brain/chapter2-isaac-percepti.title: Chapter 2: Isaac Sim for Advanced Perception Tasks
module3-ai-brain/chapter2-isaac-percepti.description: NVIDIA Isaac Sim provides a robust environment for developing and testing advanced perception algorithms critical for autonomous robotics. Leveraging its physically accurate rendering and USD-based scene description, Isaac Sim can generate high-fidelity synthetic data, which is invaluable for training and validating AI models for various perception tasks.

module3-ai-brain/chapter3-motion-plannin.title: Chapter 3: Motion Planning and Control in Isaac Sim
module3-ai-brain/chapter3-motion-plannin.description: Motion planning and control are core challenges in robotics, enabling robots to navigate their environment and interact with objects. For complex systems like humanoid robots, these tasks become significantly more intricate. NVIDIA Isaac Sim provides powerful tools and integrations to develop, test, and refine motion planning and control algorithms in a realistic and simulated environment.

module3-ai-brain/chapter4-ros2-isaac-int.title: Chapter 4: ROS 2 Integration with Isaac Sim
module3-ai-brain/chapter4-ros2-isaac-int.description: The Robot Operating System (ROS 2) is a flexible framework for writing robot software, providing tools, libraries, and conventions for building complex robot applications. Integrating ROS 2 with NVIDIA Isaac Sim combines the strengths of both platforms: Isaac Sim's high-fidelity simulation and synthetic data generation capabilities with ROS 2's powerful ecosystem for robot control, communication, and navigation.

module3-ai-brain/isaac-sim-architecture-.title: Isaac Sim Architecture Diagram (Conceptual)
module3-ai-brain/isaac-sim-architecture-.description: This document describes a conceptual diagram illustrating the high-level architecture of NVIDIA Isaac Sim and its core components. In the actual book, this would be represented by a visual diagram (e.g., SVG or PNG).

module3-ai-brain/motion-planning-workflo.description: This document describes a conceptual diagram illustrating a typical motion planning and control workflow for a robot within NVIDIA Isaac Sim. In the actual book, this would be represented by a visual diagram (e.g., SVG or PNG).

module3-ai-brain/perception-pipeline-dia.title: Perception Pipeline Diagram (Conceptual)
module3-ai-brain/perception-pipeline-dia.description: This document describes a conceptual diagram illustrating a typical perception pipeline within NVIDIA Isaac Sim, focusing on object detection, pose estimation, and semantic segmentation. uat/uat-checklist.title: User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Checklist: Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics Course
uat/uat-checklist.description: This checklist outlines the criteria for User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for the "Physical AI & Humanoid Robotics Course" book. The goal of this UAT is to ensure that the book meets the learning objectives, is user-friendly, technically accurate, and provides a high-quality educational experience for target learners.
